method.cycles: Five cycles with workspace Data Cache tag reset before each. Direct home URL -> detail -> home -> detail. Includes first post-deployment direct URL sample. Cache reset does not guarantee platform cold start. Locator observation includes polling overhead.
method.myDeckEntry: Five separate cycles. Open My Deck, wait until entry link is visible, dwell 1000ms, then measure from click until campaign card has data. Dwell time is excluded and identical before/after; prefetch is not necessarily complete. Not directly comparable with direct URL navigation.
